tables.title: Aristocratic Court — Main Theme
values: Treachery — an air of suspicion and mistrust runs through the hall
Decadence — the lord feasts while the kingdom suffers
Ennui — exhaustion and loss of meaning; the old glories are gone
Ambition — everyone is climbing, pushing, scheming upward
Resentment — bitter at rivals' crimes, real or imagined
Nobility — a genuine sense of obligation to the people and the land
Paralysis — trapped by an internal crisis no one dares name openly
Luxury — abundant wealth, rich tapestries, fine horses, generous table
Tyranny — the lord crushes those beneath him without mercy
Dissolution — the court is falling apart under outside pressure
Exoticism — following strange foreign fashions or heathen ways
Might — the court flexes its military power at every opportunity

Venerable — ancient, greatly honoured, set in its ways
Sectarian — a stronghold of one theological faction against another

Murder — operating as hired killers for the great
Smuggling — moving untaxed or forbidden goods

Slaving — capturing people for sale or ransom

Fraud — impersonating knights, forging charters, running confidence tricks
Usury — lending at brutal rates with brutal collection
Fencing — selling plunder for bandits and raiders
Occult — offering forbidden magic, love-philtres, or cursing-services
Piracy — river piracy, or organising coastal raiders
